description: Hawai'i Sea Level Rise Viewer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration; Hawai'i Department of Land and Natural Resources; State of Hawai'i. This mapping tool gives users a way assess hazards and economic vulnerabilities associated with exposure to rising sea levels in Hawai'i. The Viewer shows projections of future hazard exposure while assessing different vulnerabilities due to rising sea levels. Data in the tool come from the Hawaiʻi Sea Level Rise Vulnerability and Adaptation Report. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
